Resonance leg: y'' = −y with y(0) = 0, y(π) = 1 → refused (singular_collocation / not_converged) — the problem has no solution and is never fitted; a boundary-residual count that does not total exactly n for n state components is refused by name.

Check the envelope: status, outputs within the declared tolerance, inputs echo (inputs used == inputs submitted); every solve carries its mesh-doubling error estimate, and an estimate past the declared tol (default 1e-6) is NOT_COMPUTED not_converged with the estimate NAMED — the coarse answer is never served as a converged one; for blasius, ηMax is a declared input (default 10, range [4, 30]) so the truncated boundary is part of the record, not a hidden infinity; spectral (Chebyshev) collocation and adaptive mesh refinement are named follow-on scopes, unlisted rather than approximated.

Adversarial: NaN / 1e300 input → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; missing f, boundary residuals, or interval ends → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field; a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted; a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
